dataList.content:
Meanwhile, vast stretches of time passed within the department store.
与此同时，百货店内无数的时间流逝而去。

I was certain that the Chaplain intended to keep Meursault here until he submitted to the Grand Magasin.
牧师本打算在默尔索屈服于百货店之前，都将他关在这里。

He would lock him up in the corner of that lightless room. The room where his ailing mother had hidden herself away, once.
光线无法射入的房间的角落。痛苦中的母亲所躲藏的那间房间。

He must be desperate to leave.
他想要从中出去吧。

He must be desperate to make the pain stop.
他想要止住痛苦吧。

I could see how exhausted Meursault was—how he was hurting.
默尔索看上去既疲惫又痛苦。

Meursault, O Sinful One. There is an easy way to end that pain.
有罪之人默尔索，止住痛苦的方法十分容易。

Regret. Repent.
后悔，并悔改吧。

Your mother is enjoying a fleeting respite in that room.
汝的母亲正于那房间中享受着片刻的安宁。

Open that door again, and your sin will repeat.
若是汝再度开启那扇门扉，罪孽便会重演。

Leave the door shut if you have even a trace of regret in your heart. Stop where you are. Repent.
若是汝的心中存有悔意，就此停止开启门扉，然后悔改吧。

The voice is overbearing,
即便如此。

but Meursault opens the door anyway.
默尔索依旧打开了门。

Screaming is all that ever comes from inside the room.
其中只会一直传来悲鸣声。

I can feel that Meursault is steeped head to toe in fatigue and fear, but his face is as expressionless as a blank slate.
虽然默尔索满是疲惫与恐惧，却依旧面无表情……

Yet he opens the door still, living through the pain again.
他打开了门，让痛苦再度重演。

They are... always hard to understand.
他们……总是很难被理解。

They try to assign their own meanings to the world. Different meanings through arbitrary means.
他们试图赋予世界各自的意义。以随意的方式赋予彼此不同的意义。

... No. The fact is...
不，事实上……

The fact is that I do understand them. That is the precise reason that I am consumed by this unending vertigo.
我可以理解他们……所以我才被无尽的眩晕所侵蚀。

Mother told me that assigning meanings is the only way for human beings to endure this world.
他们，也就是人类，正是赋予了意义才能忍耐下去的存在，妈妈说道。

One, however, cannot hope to assign meanings to everything, as the world is too vast and formidable to allow such a thing.
但若要赋予一切以意义，世界却又太过广大，难以企及。

And so they entrust themselves to the inertia that the City has created in the name of civilization and culture. Some drift like buoys on waves, without even knowing where the current flows.
因此，他们才委身于都市以文明与文化之名创造出的惯性。如同浮标一般随波逐流。

Nailed in place with no one but myself, I keep on watching them, my vision swimming with dizziness.
我独自被钉住，凝视着他们。感受着茫然的眩晕。

They will continue to change and waver even amid those waves.
从今往后，他们依旧会在那片浪涛中不断变化与摇动吧。

What was once believed to be a revelation, an enlightenment, is overturned in an instant. What is believed to be right will change with the passing of time.
曾经领悟并相信的事情会在一瞬间被推翻，曾经相信是正确的事情会随着时间流逝而改变。

... I know.
……我知道。

dataList.content:
Do I look like I'm going to stay this way forever?
在你这家伙眼中，我看起来像是会一直保持这样吗？

I might let blind rage swing my blade again. Might get sick of all of this, or might even start hurting again.
我既可能再次被愤怒蒙蔽双眼，从而重新挥舞刀刃，也有可能对一切感到厌烦或是陷入痛苦之中。

But...
但是……

Right now, this is where I've chosen to stay.
我现在只打算待在这里。

If the clock keeps yapping, I'll clean out my ears. If this damn scabbard gets in my way, I'll just have to keep it pacified. That's all I need to do.
如果时钟滴答个没完，我就掏一掏耳朵。如果这烦人的刀鞘要妨碍我，我就哄一哄它。这就够了。

I do not understand.
我无法理解。

The countless gazes, the meanings that fall apart, the possibility of being wrong, the existence of this world...
诸多的视线，崩塌的意义，对可能出错的担忧，这个世界的存在……

... they all frighten me.
都让我恐惧。

How do they endure this fear?
他们究竟是如何忍耐这份恐惧的呢。

<... I'll be honest, I'm feeling a bit lost. I don't have any clues... let alone any hope of finding one.>
<……没有方法呢。也看不到一丝希望。>

<而且……以后也一定还会如此吧。>

<I know we might just end up proving Jeanne right, with nothing changing from our last attempt. But we can cross that bridge when we get to it.>
<如果结局没有变化……那时候就再重新想想。>

<I know. I just thought having a choice might make the whole thing more fun for Pwie.>
<我知道。但我还是想让这件事变得更有趣一些。>

dataList.content:
These people also lack certainty in their own judgment.
他们也不对自身的判断抱有确信。

Why, then, do they repeat actions that even they themselves fail to understand?
若是如此，他们为何要重复连自身都无法理解的行为呢。

I am in a world in which one must fathom the unfathomable to endure one's existence.
理解无法理解之物才能忍耐下去的世界。

It is a world that, for that very reason, tortured Mother all her life.
正因如此，妈妈才不得不痛苦一生的世界。

And her suffering was passed down to me, like an inheritance.
然后，我也就此接受了那份痛苦，重蹈覆辙。

I put all of that behind.
将那些全都抛之脑后，

Without even fully understanding what is pushing me to act...
如今，我依旧在无法完全理解自身行为的情况下……

I open the door to Mother's room.
打开了妈妈关上的房门。

<color=#7d7d7d>.......</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>……</color>

<color=#7d7d7d>So, in the end... You choose that interminable suffering once again.</color>
<color=#7d7d7d>最终，汝依旧选择了那份无尽的痛苦吗。</color>
